topic: Nagato never used Limbo because Madara's borrowed eyes never became his
title: Why Nagato Never Used Madara's Limbo
description: Madara used Limbo with the same Rinnegan that Nagato carried for years, yet Nagato never once did. Here is my read on why the borrowed eyes mattered. Do you buy it?
comment: Was Nagato just not strong enough to use Limbo, or did borrowed eyes make it impossible? Pick one.

lines.text: Nagato had Madara's Rinnegan and never once used Limbo.

shot.fallback: pale red haired man with ripple eyes

lines.text: Madara used it to crush every tailed beast. So why not Nagato?

shot.fallback: dark haired warrior with ripple eyes and ghostly clones

lines.text: Here's my read, and it starts with whose eyes those really were.

shot.fallback: old ninja with ripple pattern eyes

lines.text: Madara planted that Rinnegan in a little Uzumaki boy.

shot.fallback: child with red hair and strange eyes

lines.text: Nagato got a gift. Madara got something else, because Madara's eyes had awakened in him.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with glowing eyes

lines.text: Look at what Nagato did use instead: six bodies, Almighty Push, Chibaku Tensei.

shot.search: Nagato Six Paths of Pain Chibaku Tensei
shot.fallback: six men with piercings under a floating rock

lines.text: Every one of those is a Path of Pain. Limbo isn't on that list.

shot.search: Six Paths of Pain Deva Path
shot.fallback: men with piercings and ripple eyes

lines.text: Here's the detail most people forget.

shot.fallback: ghostly black clone beside a warrior

lines.text: With only one Rinnegan eye, Madara could make just one shadow. Both eyes gave him four.

shot.fallback: ghostly black clones around a warrior

lines.text: Limbo scaled with Madara's own eyes. That suggests it was always his, not the Rinnegan's.
People say Nagato was simply never strong enough. But he beat Jiraiya with six bodies.

shot.fallback: bearded ninja fighting an older white haired man

lines.text: So my theory: Limbo was never a Rinnegan power. It was Madara's.

shot.fallback: dark haired warrior with ghostly clone

lines.text: And that's why Nagato had Madara's eyes, but never Madara's Limbo.
